description: Leads co-folded against FULLY-MODIFIED Tirzepatide = peptide (Aib2,Aib13) + K20 acyl (C20-diacid-gGlu-(AEEA)2, from user SMILES) as co-folded ligand. protein_iptm = binder<->peptide interface confidence.
conclusion: K20 lipid present -> binder<->peptide protein_iptm stays 0.95-0.98 (>= lipid-free). The C-terminal helical epitope (F22/V23/L26/I27) is not occluded by the lipid, which is on the opposite face. Binders tolerate the full modification.
